about.description: Solv Protocol is a multi-chain Bitcoin yield aggregator and tokenization platform, founded in 2021 by Ryan Chow, Meng Yan, and Will Wang. While the SOLV governance token has a Bond & MMF category designation, the protocol's primary product is SolvBTC, a yield-bearing BTC wrapper that has grown to $1B+ in TVL. Solv also offers BTC-backed tokenized funds via partnerships with institutional asset managers (BlackRock BUIDL, Mountain USDM, etc.) and pioneered the ERC-3525 semi-fungible-token standard. SOLV is listed on Binance and other major exchanges.
about.registryInfo: Solv Protocol is operated by the Solv Foundation, a Cayman Islands not-for-profit foundation. The SOLV token is the protocol's governance and utility token. Founders: Ryan Chow (CEO), Meng Yan, Will Wang. Backed by Binance Labs, Blockchain Capital, IOSG Ventures, Mirana Ventures, and others. Solv pioneered the ERC-3525 semi-fungible token standard. The protocol's flagship product is SolvBTC, a Bitcoin yield aggregator with $1B+ TVL.

fees.revenueNotes: Solv Protocol's primary revenue is from SolvBTC, a Bitcoin yield aggregator with $1B+ TVL. Solv retains a performance fee on yield generated by SolvBTC strategies (typically 10-15% based on comparable yield-aggregator norms, exact rate not publicly disclosed). SOLV governance token captures a portion of protocol revenue via the Solv DAO. Source: https://docs.solv.finance/
